label: run165 load resource rrs
definition: Structural forward build (G4): run164 + the enrollment-driven forward load-resource RRS-UFR credit (ercot_load_resource_reserve) — the LAST measured AS *input* on the supply side given a forward analogue. Load Resources provide Responsive Reserve via under-frequency relays (RRS-UFR, an ERCOT-protocol load-side-only service the co-opt omitted); the credit nets it off the RRS product's reserve-balance RHS after the demand curve is sized to the gross peak (tail preserved). Mode-aware: BACKCAST reads the measured NP3-911 (~0.9 GW, byte-identical), FORECAST reads the enrollment forward lr_rrs(t)=enrolled_DR_MW(year)x mean-1 availability shape (enrollment ~0.9 GW today -> ~1.4 GW protocol cap). Composes with the RTOLCAP cap (300b89c) and endogenous storage AS (ea8c656) with no double count (load resources are outside RTOLCAP). Acute HELD vs run164: May 8/24/26 $24.6/$21.7/$30.2; tail RELAXES per the designed forward response (more load-side reserve -> fewer scarcity hours): h>$200 36/4/1 vs run164 57/12/3, model annual 30.0/20.7/33.0 vs 34.3/21.3/33.1. Measured-vs-forward load-resource RRS (mean MW): measured 884/904/787 vs enrollment 780/840/900 (0.88-1.14x — trend reproduces the present level, not pinned to the year wiggle).
